01 / Understanding the organisation

One mission. Four clear ways to take part.

The current i.c.stars website serves several distinct audiences. The proposed direction brings those pathways forward so visitors can recognise their next step without searching through the whole site.

01 — APPLY

For future stars

Explain the programme, who it is designed for, what participants can expect and how to begin.

02 — HIRE

For employers

Make the talent model, graduate value and employer connection route easy to understand.

03 — INVEST

For funders

Connect the mission to the opportunity to support economic mobility and talent development.

04 — ENGAGE

For the community

Surface practical ways to mentor, volunteer, attend events, donate resources or sponsor.

07 / Design rationale

Design decisions connected to real needs.

A starting point to validate with participants, staff and stakeholders.

01 / CLARITY

Recognisable pathways

Make Apply, Hire, Invest and Engage visible as distinct routes for different audiences.

02 / CONTENT

Human proof

Use participant stories, programme details and real project context to explain the model.

03 / ACCESS

Responsive foundations

Design readable layouts and clear interactions across desktop, tablet and mobile.

04 / VALIDATION

Test with people

Validate navigation, comprehension and application tasks with participants and stakeholders.

Make the next step easier to see — and easier to take.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss this direction, learn from the i.c.stars team and develop the experience around the needs of the people it serves.
